```{r setupFigs, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(momentuHMM)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggforce)
library(wesanderson)
library(glmmTMB)
library(splines)
library(ggridges)



knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

colPal = c(
  'navy',
  '#0c6980',  # Deep teal
  '#7eaba6',  # Seafoam
  '#e3bc5d',  # Soft amber
  '#ffd966',  # Pale gold
  '#ff8d8d',  # Coral pink
  '#6e2f2f',  # Deep burgundy brown (contrasts well with light tones)
  '#344e41'   # Olive forest green (earthy and complementary)
)

Sexcols <- colPal[c(7,5)]

# grab custom ggplot theme + theme_nature()
source("../../../CH2_BNForg/Scripts-HMM/src/natureTheme.R")

# Ensure local self-contained project folder exists before any local saves below
dir.create("../../figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

```{r forgMod1, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,error=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

#source("../../src/12.ForagingModel.R")

# Build the grid
forgModFinal <- readRDS(file = "../../src_outputs/bestForgMod.rds")
environment(forgModFinal$call$formula) <- environment()

grid_4way <- expand.grid(
  nearestTide = seq(0,3.6,length.out = 100),
  moonFraction = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
  lightPeriod = levels(forgModFinal$frame$lightPeriod),
  season = levels(forgModFinal$frame$season)
) %>%
  mutate(
    LOCBANDED = factor("HER", levels = levels(forgModFinal$frame$LOCBANDED)),
    BandNumber = as.character("101-18502")
  )

# Build the spline basis
spline_cols <- ns(
  x = grid_4way$nearestTide,
  knots = c(0.913, 1.323, 1.793, 2.267),
  Boundary.knots = c(0.013, 3.505),
  intercept = FALSE
)

colnames(spline_cols) <- colnames(forgModFinal$frame[, grepl("^ns\\(nearestTide", colnames(forgModFinal$frame))])

# Bind spline columns but DO NOT drop nearestTide
grid_4way <- cbind(grid_4way, as.data.frame(spline_cols))

# Now build model matrix
mm <- model.matrix(
  delete.response(terms(forgModFinal)),
  data = grid_4way,
  contrasts.arg = forgModFinal$frame$contrasts
)

# Manually predict
lp <- mm %*% fixef(forgModFinal)$cond
grid_4way$pred <- plogis(lp)



grid_4way$season<-factor(grid_4way$season, levels = c( "Autumn", "Winter", "Spring", "Summer"))

p1 <- ggplot(grid_4way%>%dplyr::filter(lightPeriod=="Dark"), aes(x = nearestTide, y = pred, color = factor(moonFraction))) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=colPal[2:6])+
  facet_wrap(~ season, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Tide Height (m)",
    y = "P(On the island)",
    color = "Moon Fraction"  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
    theme_nature()+
  xlim(c(0,3))
```

```{r forgMod2, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE,error=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, out.width='100%', fig.cap="a) Predicted probability of Pacific Reef Egrets being on-colony across tide heights under varying moon fraction (moon illumination) conditions, and seasons at night. Facets separate combinations of season and moon fraction. b) Colony-specific on-colony probability predictions in response to tide heights in Eastern Reef Egrets from Heron Island and One Tree Island during the summer season, under day conditions and 50% moon illumination. Dotted line (1.5m) represents 95th percentile tide height for access to reef crest foraging areas, dashed line (2m) represents 95th percentile tide height for access to outer reef flat."}

# 1. Build the grid
grid_colony <- expand.grid(
  nearestTide = seq(0, 3.6, length.out = 100),
  LOCBANDED = levels(forgModFinal$frame$LOCBANDED)
) %>%
  mutate(
    moonFraction = 0.5,
    lightPeriod = factor("Light", levels = levels(forgModFinal$frame$lightPeriod)),
    season = factor("Summer", levels = levels(forgModFinal$frame$season)),
    BandNumber = as.character("101-18502")   # must not be NA
  )

# 2. Build spline basis manually
spline_cols <- ns(
  x = grid_colony$nearestTide,
  knots = c(0.913, 1.323, 1.793, 2.267),
  Boundary.knots = c(0.013, 3.505),
  intercept = FALSE
)

colnames(spline_cols) <- colnames(forgModFinal$frame[, grepl("^ns\\(nearestTide", colnames(forgModFinal$frame))])

# 3. Bind spline basis (keep nearestTide!)
grid_colony <- cbind(grid_colony, as.data.frame(spline_cols))

# 4. Predict manually
# Build model matrix
mm_colony <- model.matrix(
  delete.response(terms(forgModFinal)),
  data = grid_colony,
  contrasts.arg = forgModFinal$frame$contrasts
)

# Manual prediction
lp_colony <- mm_colony %*% fixef(forgModFinal)$cond
grid_colony$pred <- plogis(lp_colony)

p2 <- ggplot(grid_colony, aes(x = nearestTide, y = pred, color = LOCBANDED)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=colPal[c(2,6)])+
  labs(
    x = "Tide Height (m)",
    y = "P(On the island)",
    color = "Colony"  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype='dotted')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2, linetype='dashed')+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
  theme_nature()

forage_tide_moon<-p1+p2+plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')+plot_layout(widths = c(2,3))

saveRDS(forage_tide_moon, "~/OneDrive - James Cook University/Projects/THESIS_SEABIRDS_2025/figures/CH6_Fig1_forageEnvironmentalInteractions.rds")

# Local copy for self-contained project folder (for sharing with reviewers)
# Wrapped in tryCatch so a local sync/permissions issue never halts the render
tryCatch({
  saveRDS(forage_tide_moon, "../../figures/CH6_Fig1_forageEnvironmentalInteractions.rds")
  ggsave("../../figures/CH6_Fig1_forageEnvironmentalInteractions.png", forage_tide_moon, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}, error = function(e) message("Local reviewer-copy save skipped (CH6_Fig1): ", conditionMessage(e)))

forage_tide_moon
```

```{r kdeFidelityGAMMs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=7, echo=FALSE,out.width='100%',fig.cap="a) Predicted seasonal changes in 95% kernel density estimate (KDE) area for males and females, reflecting the extent of individual foraging ranges, island locations not included. Estimates are conditional on average daytime tide height b) Effect of monthly mean daytime tide height on KDE area, with predictions conditioned on female sex and the month of June as reference levels for factor variables c) Predicted change in site fidelity (Bhattacharyya’s Affinity index) with increasing time between monthly observations, by sex d) Predicted seasonal variation in foraging site fidelity by sex. Shaded ribbons show 95% confidence intervals in all panels."}

fidelitySeasonPlot<-readRDS("../../src_outputs/fidelitySeasonPlot_GAMM.rds")+ 
  scale_colour_manual(values=Sexcols)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=Sexcols)+
  theme_nature()
fidelityIntervalPlot<-readRDS("../../src_outputs/fidelityIntervalPlot_GAMM.rds")+ 
  scale_colour_manual(values=Sexcols)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=Sexcols)+
  theme_nature()

saveRDS(fidelitySeasonPlot,"~/OneDrive - James Cook University/Projects/THESIS_SEABIRDS_2025/figures/CH6_Fig2b_fidelitySeasonPlot.rds")
saveRDS(fidelityIntervalPlot,"~/OneDrive - James Cook University/Projects/THESIS_SEABIRDS_2025/figures/CH6_Fig2d_fidelityIntervalPlot.rds")

# Local copy for self-contained project folder (for sharing with reviewers)
# Wrapped in tryCatch so a local sync/permissions issue never halts the render
tryCatch({
  saveRDS(fidelitySeasonPlot,"../../figures/CH6_Fig2b_fidelitySeasonPlot.rds")
  saveRDS(fidelityIntervalPlot,"../../figures/CH6_Fig2d_fidelityIntervalPlot.rds")
  ggsave("../../figures/CH6_Fig2b_fidelitySeasonPlot.png", fidelitySeasonPlot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  ggsave("../../figures/CH6_Fig2d_fidelityIntervalPlot.png", fidelityIntervalPlot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}, error = function(e) message("Local reviewer-copy save skipped (CH6_Fig2b/2d): ", conditionMessage(e)))

(kdeSeasonPlot + fidelitySeasonPlot)/(kdeTidePlot + fidelityIntervalPlot)+plot_layout(tag_level = 'new', guides = 'collect') +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c('a', 'c','b','d'), '1'))

```
